description: Metalwork covers the science and craft of shaping metal: shop safety, alloys and heat treatment, basic metalworking exercises, and one craft track: sheet metal, silversmithing, casting or blacksmithing.

safety.note: Metalwork involves heat, sharp edges and molten metal: wear eye, hand and foot protection and work only under a qualified adult.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the structure (safety, metal science, work-hardening and annealing, career or hobby research, and one project track: sheet metal, silversmithing, founding or blacksmithing) but not full numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
